'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]

[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] say that they shot down seven of the ten missiles. '''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 Asia heat wave]]
**The [[Politics of Beijing|government]] of [[Beijing]], [[China]], orders employers to suspend [[outdoor work]] due to [[Heat wave|extreme temperatures]] expected to reach {{convert|40|C}}. [https://apnews.com/article/china-heat-weather-flood-7a2ef4f89ebbf63cd8158f1954c78633 (AP)]

The volcano last erupted in [[Fagradalsfjall#2022 eruption|2022]]. [https://www.icelandreview.com/news/fagradalsfjall-update-quakes-continue-eruption-likely/ (Iceland Review)]
